headline: Nvidia Halts Sales to Southeast Asia as U.S. Tightens China Restrictions
summary: Nvidia has halted sales to four Southeast Asian countries following a new U.S. rule requiring licenses for companies in those countries to purchase advanced A.I. chips.
why: Export controls on advanced semiconductors impact major tech companies' global supply chains and regional distribution strategies.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Export restrictions limit the company's addressable market in the affected countries.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Stricter export controls restrict sales of advanced semiconductors to additional international markets.
